source_title: Q3 Contract Prices of NAND Flash Products Constrained by Increased Production and Lower End-User Demand; Estimated to Rise by 5–10%, Says TrendForce
claim_relevant_visible_text: This year, NAND Flash prices saw a robust rebound as manufacturers kept production in check during the first half, helping them regain profitability.
researcher_paraphrase: TrendForce explicitly linked the first-half 2024 NAND price rebound to restrained production, while the same source separately described AI-supported enterprise demand and weak consumer electronics demand.
precision_guard: The exact excerpt grounds the production-control explanation for the observed first-half rebound. The broader source context distinguishes enterprise-AI strength from weak consumer demand but does not quantify causal shares.
authority_boundary: TrendForce is methodological-primary for its own NAND market measurement and forecast framing, not a primary supplier production ledger.
